ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45% high-intensity (white) distal coverage vs 55% low-intensity (black) medial and peduncle coverage.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large high-intensity white contiguous blocks are located on the distal half of both the left and right lobes. The central region (approx. 30% of total width) consists of a solid low-intensity black mass. The right lobe contains vertical high-contrast black linear streaks (approx. 5-7 lines) within the white field. The left lobe contains diffuse black mottling and horizontal linear disruptions on its leading and trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A sharp V-shaped depression with an approximate internal angle of 65 degrees, extending deep into the fluke body toward the peduncle axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, low-amplitude serrations across the majority of the trailing edge; a cluster of high-frequency pixel variations (peaks) is visible on the distal 10% of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edges exhibit a concave sweep from the median notch toward the distal tips, while the leading edges show a convex curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, circular high-contrast white spots detected in the lower-medial dark region; a cluster of small circular dark spots is visible on the inner-distal white patch of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Significant detection of vertical and diagonal high-contrast linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the central dark-to-light boundary on both lobes, most prominent in the center-left and distal-right regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive vertical linear rake marks across the central axis; significant irregular brownish-yellow pixel accumulation and ragged edge topography at the tip of the right lobe, indicating trauma or biological fouling.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique ochre-colored pigmentation cluster localized specifically on the superior margin of the right fluke tip.
